item.title: EastWest Helps You Save P7 Per Liter At UniOil This December
item.description: As fuel prices continue to climb, EastWest is giving motorists a practical way to keep going. The Bank has renewed its partnership with Unioil for 2026 to offer significant fuel savings per liter, a simple boost that helps Filipinos stay mobile without the extra strain on the budget.Read More »

item.title: Review: 2025 Toyota GR Yaris 8AT
item.description: You could say that the Toyota GR Yaris is a personal forbidden fruit. Just as I was supposed to sample one in 2021, one nasty accident meant Toyota Motor Philippines pulled the entire GR press fleet out of rotation. That was four years ago. Now that some select hacks have earned Toyota’s trust, I opted to try the updated GR Yaris for myself, and boy, was the wait worth it.Read More »

item.title: FUSO Canter Now Available With Crane, Refrigerated Body Styles
item.description: Following the launch of the F-Wing body on the Fuso FJ2528R (now FJ2828R) in 2022, Sojitz Fuso Philippines Corporation, in partnership with Centro Manufacturing Corporation (CMC), launched the two new purpose-built body applications for the Fuso Canter—the F-resh Van and F-Lift. These truck body applications further strengthen Fuso’s commitment in providing timely mobility solutions designed to meet the evolving demands of local Filipino businesses.Read More »

item.title: Lexus Brings Back The LFA As A High-Performance EV Sportscar
item.description: The Lexus Sports Concept gets a proper name as it inches closer towards production. Now known as the Lexus LFA Concept, it was shown alongside the stunning Toyota GR GT and GR GT3. The thing is, the LFA stays a concept for now, but eventually it’ll hit showrooms as a high-performance battery electric vehicle.Read More »

item.title: Meet The Most Powerful Production Porsche Of All Time, And Yes, It's An All-Electric SUV!
item.description: The Porsche Cayenne enters a new era as it goes fully electric for its latest generation. In doing so, the fourth-generation model becomes the most powerful production Porsche of all time with its 1,156-horsepower output. It’s also one of the quickest with a 0 to 100 km/h time of 2.5 seconds.Read More »

item.title: Next Generation Tamaraw Ambassador And Owner Coco Martin Talks About His Favorite Feature Of Toyota's Utility Vehicle
item.description: Abante Posible Ambassador Coco Martin met with Marileños and Bulakeños at Marilao, Bulacan during the nationwide Tamaraw roadshow organized by Toyota Motor Philippines (TMP) and Toyota Marilao, Bulacan, Inc. (TMR). Marilao is Coco’s third provincial stop after Cagayan De Oro and Tacloban, where customers have been sharing their stories of Abante Posible with the next-generation Toyota Tamaraw.Read More »
